summary: Completed visual redesign testing for Daleel Pets dark premium SaaS theme. All features working correctly: dark theme (#060B14 background), glassmorphism cards, teal #00D4B4 accents, sidebar with teal glow active state, collapsible sidebar. All pages load correctly with dark theme - no white backgrounds visible.

POST /api/auth/login works correctly with admin credentials
GET /api/stores returns all stores with Tier 4 status
GET /api/encryption/verify returns {status: 'active', ok: true}
Login page loads with dark theme - radial gradient background (#0A0F1E to #060B14)
Login form works correctly (admin@daleelpets.com / admin123) - redirects to dashboard
Dashboard/My Products page loads with dark KPI cards and data table
Sidebar navigation works - all 6 nav items functional (Dashboard, Insights, Scanner, Discounts, Alerts, Stores)
Settings link in sidebar works
Sidebar collapse/expand button works correctly
Stores page loads with Tier 4 column visible (showing Expired/Not Set Up badges)
Insights page loads correctly with charts (Revenue Leaderboard, Top Sellers, Trending)
Scanner page loads correctly (Price Opportunity Scanner with overpriced products)
Discounts page loads correctly (Store Discount Aggression Leaderboard)
Alerts page loads correctly
Settings page loads with Tier 4 credential vault (Store Accounts section)
Settings Verify Encryption button shows green status ('Encryption Active — Fernet AES-128')
Store name links navigate to competitor profile page (tested with Zarafa)

No white backgrounds found - dark theme is consistent across all pages
Text readability verified - white (#FFFFFF), teal (#00D4B4), muted gray (#9CA3AF) colors
